reason: 15 to 20 minutes during a nap is something I can actually do, unlike the 45-minute workouts I keep giving up on, and the free week means I can see if I stick with it before paying. At $19.99 one-off with a refund it's barely a decision, so if I get through the first week I'd buy the full eight.
objection: Honestly it's me, not the program. I buy these things when I'm feeling motivated and then the baby's sleep changes or teething starts and I just stop. I'd worry I'd pay and quit by week three like last time.
